description: Postfix mail server config audit — Offline security audit of a Postfix main.cf: open-relay detection (smtpd_relay_restrictions / smtpd_recipient_restrictions order, bare permit before reject_unauth_destination, mynetworks 0.0.0.0/0 or wide public ranges, mynetworks_style, allow_untrusted_routing), inbound and outbound STARTTLS level, missing certificate, SMTP AUTH without smtpd_tls_auth_only, anonymous SASL, obsolete SSLv3/TLSv1/TLSv1.1 protocols, export/low ciphers, VRFY enumeration, HELO, version-leaking banner, rate limits, compatibility_level, duplicates (last wins). Returns PASS / REVIEW / FIX BEFORE DEPLOY / BLOCK, score, grade, findings with line numbers and fixes, plus a hardened main.cf. Params: text= (main.cf contents) or url= (raw file or GitHub blob URL). Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description:
mynetworks = 0.0.0.0/0
smtpd_relay_restrictions = permit_mynetworks, reject_unauth_destination
smtpd_sasl_auth_enable = yes

name: security_postfix_check
